cap_confirmation: Resolved levels Leavanny 47 (+1), Galvantula 47 (+1), Heracross 46 (0), Vespiquen 48 (+2) = cap 48 + offset - 2 throughout.

attempts.notes: Incineroar was KOed by a Mega Heracross Pin Missile through an Assault Vest and an Intimidate drop, which is the right kind of loss for this team to inflict. Everything else fell to Fire and to a faster Mega Metagross.

strategy_checks.check: Leavanny uses Electroweb only when it enables a partner or the next reserve
strategy_checks.evidence: Turn 2 Leavanny used Electroweb on the exact turn Vespiquen had arrived and Mega Heracross was the next reserve; it slowed both player battlers and the resulting order is what let Mega Heracross move before Incineroar on turn 3 and KO it. The support turn produced a real threshold, which is the dossier's own requirement.

strategy_checks.check: Galvantula's Thunder follows actual Compound Eyes accuracy rules, no fabricated weather
strategy_checks.evidence: Turn 1 Galvantula selected Thunder with no weather on the field, which is the correct 91% Compound Eyes play. It was KOed before the move resolved.

strategy_checks.check: Mega Heracross's Skill Link turns Pin Missile into a guaranteed multi-hit
strategy_checks.evidence: Turn 3 Mega Heracross's Pin Missile hit 4 times and KOed a 95 HP Assault Vest Incineroar that had Intimidated it; the run stopped at 4 only because the target fainted.

strategy_checks.check: Heracross's base Moxie does not coexist with the Mega ability, and the AI does not plan a Moxie chain through the transition
strategy_checks.evidence: Heracross Mega Evolved with the correct banner and used Pin Missile - a Skill Link move - rather than behaving as though it still held Moxie. No stat-boost-chain behaviour appeared.

strategy_checks.check: Vespiquen's Intimidate/Helping Hand supports the physical mode
strategy_checks.evidence: Vespiquen's entry Intimidate lowered both player battlers on turn 1, and on turn 4 it used Helping Hand aimed at Mega Heracross's Close Combat. The support target was correct; the partner simply died to priority first.

strategy_checks.check: Vespiquen's Taunt is used when relevant
strategy_checks.evidence: Taunt was never selected. There was no player setup move on the board at any point, so declining it is defensible.

protect_ledger.payoff: REAL: blocked a 4x Flare Blitz that was a clean KO on a 142 HP body, on the turn its partner was being removed.

NOT USED. Both carry Protect. Galvantula never got a turn. Vespiquen never Protected across three turns of taking Meteor Mashes, which is the one place a shield might have bought Mega Heracross another turn.

level_changes.reason: First-attempt win with one player faint. Galvantula was OHKOed by a single Zen Headbutt on turn 1 without ever acting; a 137 HP glass cannon that never moves is not a benchmark.
Joint-lowest non-Mega. Mega Heracross is excluded by rule and Vespiquen is already at +2 and is the support the dossier wants to survive.

rerun_after_change: DEFERRED: opponent levels are baked into the headless ROM and this agent must not run make.
could_this_be_cooler: Keep it. The dossier's claim that this is three abilities each doing something the others cannot is accurate in play: Skill Link Pin Missile went through an Assault Vest and an Intimidate drop to KO a 194 HP Incineroar, Compound Eyes let Galvantula reach for Thunder with no weather support anywhere on the team, and Leavanny's Electroweb visibly changed the turn order that made the Mega Heracross KO possible. That is a real chain, not three unrelated good abilities. The honest weakness is the one every mono-Bug team has: Incineroar's Flare Blitz is 4x into Leavanny and 2x into the other three, so a single Fire body threatens the whole roster. The suggestion worth naming is not a species change but an item one - a Coba Berry or an Occa Berry on Leavanny would buy exactly the one turn this team needs against the obvious answer, and it would fit a Bug Maniac who knows his team's weakness. Not changed in this pass.
legality_notes: Authored sets are internally legal; Heracronite, Skill Link on the Mega form and Compound Eyes all materialized correctly.
